messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — Peregrine Systems DAU for inference API dropped ~90% yesterday (from ~12.1k API calls/day to ~1.3k). Saw a sharp spike then near-zero. Anyone recently on enablement or procurement touchpoints?
AJ Patel: ugh, thanks for flagging. We had a QBR with them 3 wks ago. Procurement mentioned evaluating EchoAI for a cost trial.
Noah Rivera: ran the usage query, here's the tail of the series:
```
2026-03-18 12100
2026-03-19 11850
2026-03-20 11000
2026-03-21 300
2026-03-22 1200
```
Mia Chen: thanks. can someone check whether keys/service were rotated or if there's an SSO/procurement hold?
Olivia Tsai: quick audit — last deploy key rotation 2026-03-21 03:10 UTC. No SSO incidents in the tenancy. However payments system showed a bounced billing email on 2026-03-22.
onboarding-bot: Payment method failure detected for Peregrine Systems (invoice 4567). Last payment attempted 2026-03-22 09:02 UTC.
AJ Patel: that could explain it — if billing blocked provisioning for their dedicated pool, calls would stop. They are on a small dedicated capacity plan.
Noah Rivera: confirm: dedicated pool + API keys. I'll check api-key status and flag infra if routing/gateway blocked.
Mia Chen: immediate playbook: 1) AJ to call procurement contact, 2) Noah to confirm api keys & gateway health, 3) Olivia to resend invoice and billing note, 4) I'll schedule a quick triage with CSM + PM if needed.
AJ Patel: calling procurement now, will update thread.
Noah Rivera: pinged eng-infra in channel for a routing/gateway check (@eng-infra).
Olivia Tsai: billing email resent, cc'd legal and finance.
Mia Chen: if EchoAI pilot is live, let's also offer a short config session to demonstrate cost/latency differences — low-friction win.
AJ Patel: on call — procurement rep says they put a temporary pause for new calls due to a budget freeze and are starting EchoAI trial next week. Quote from them: "pausing new production calls while we test the pilot".
Sam (eng-infra): api-key for Peregrine was suspended automatically due to unpaid invoice; I manually reinstated the key and verified routing. Monitoring backend 1h for traffic recovery.
Noah Rivera: confirmed reinstated keys. Watching for prefix/KV cache warm-up.
Mia Chen: good. if usage does not rebound after billing fix, escalate to account exec for the competitive playbook (demo + short performance deep-dive). I'll check back in 1h with telemetry. Thanks team :thumbsup:
